key_insight: A variational latent neural field can jointly predict reduced-order dynamics, quantify uncertainty, and exactly preserve conservation laws for nonlinear PDEs.
engineering_relevance: This offers a surrogate modeling path for CFD and multiphysics applications where fast parameter sweeps are needed but physics consistency and confidence estimates are essential.
method: Uses Gaussian process-inspired latent surrogates to estimate predictive uncertainty.
Compares three variants: IRS-UQ, PI-IRS-UQ, and ECLEIRS-UQ.
Enforces exact conservation via a space-time divergence-free solution-flux representation on a conservation-law manifold.
evidence_signal: The framework is evaluated on 1-D advection, 2-D Euler, and 2-D shallow water systems under parameterized settings, including sparse and noisy training data.
watch_item: The conservation-preserving formulation may be more complex to implement and train than unconstrained latent models, especially for high-dimensional CFD systems.
paper_title: Structure-preserving variational neural fields: Uncertainty-quantified reduced-order modeling of nonlinear conservation laws
